name: ldl_factor
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::linalg_ldl_factor(Tensor self, *, bool hermitian=False) -> (Tensor LD, Tensor pivots). Computes a compact LDL factorization without mutating or aliasing self. Tests preserve float32/float64 square-matrix and hermitian coverage and additionally cover batches, output metadata, input non-mutation, and invalid rank, shape, dtype, and implementation-size limits.
